rule: Headline learning stores reusable construction patterns and repair outcomes, not publisher phrasing.

audit.rule: Accepted headline patterns must remain grammatically natural and story-identity safe. Word-salad approvals are retroactively moved to rejected memory so they stop teaching the Writer bad behavior.

generalizedFailureClassLearning.rule: Accepted headline memory must store reusable successful structures, not exact bad strings. Exact bad titles are examples of headline-integrity failures.

headline-integrity.label: Headline integrity failure
headline-integrity.detect: Any scrambled, clipped, generic, copied, or body-mismatched headline, even when the exact bad words are new.
headline-integrity.repair: Rebuild headline from Story Dossier and completed body; resubmit headline-only when body is otherwise sound.
headline-integrity.prevent: Headline Generator must use actor + action + consequence and verify body overlap before editor review.

blockingRules: Do not copy publisher headline wording or phrase order.
Do not preserve live update, at a glance, what to know, watch, analysis, or explainer framing.
Do not publish generic status headlines such as report adds details, comes into focus, raises questions, or draws attention.
Do not publish truncated headlines ending in connector words.
Do not publish headline/body mismatches or stacked keyword subjects.
